work.company: 北京六艺观化科技有限公司 / 六艺AI
work.summary: Founded and led an AI-powered traditional-culture report product from product definition to full-stack implementation, payment, report delivery, operations, and deployment.
highlights: Built the public product at www.liuyi.life with React 19, Vite, TypeScript, FastAPI, Postgres, DingMing, GenService, Dulupay, systemd, nginx, and CDN.
Designed the full delivery loop from birth data and questionnaire to structured analysis, free preview, paid/voucher unlock, full report generation, and report retrieval.
Developed internal tooling around SKU configuration, Ops Dashboard, GenMonitor, voucher scripts, and deployment documentation.

work.company: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence (BIGAI)
work.summary: Worked on Any2Any multimodal understanding/generation systems and the MAGUS multi-agent multimodal framework.
highlights: Surveyed and evaluated VILA-U, NeXT-GPT, Wan2.1, Open-Sora, Qwen2.5-Omni, Wan2.1-VACE, AudioLDM2, and EmotiVoice.
Participated in multimodal instruction data construction, VAE projector exploration, MLLM evaluation, and modular model orchestration.
Contributed to MAGUS, which uses role-conditioned MLLM agents and Growth-Aware Search to coordinate LLM reasoning with diffusion generation.
